document.slice: P1A.1 — real Settings page and persistence; the full inbound pilot remains in progress

implemented: Lazy-loaded Business Manager /manager/leads Settings page and configurable Leads & Conversations menu item
Business/contact/support details, enquiry/content/fallback owner and advisor team
Bounded 50-result team search with selected-member retention and cancelled obsolete requests
Spanish/English/Portuguese selection, greeting and after-hours message
IANA timezone, up to 28 non-overlapping weekly coverage intervals and 100 closed dates
Save incomplete drafts, explicit publication, stale-write protection and immutable published snapshots
Same-company active staff validation on save and publish; audit records without transcript/config payload logging
Server authority from verified active account/company plus active organisation_owner or student-operations chief_executive; menu visibility alone never grants access
Scoped loader, timed shared toast, invalid-field states, mobile/dark styling and trapped-focus reload confirmation
authorization: The identity bridge resolves company and active manager authority; settings data is read/written only after SET LOCAL ROLE sophia_runtime_app with tenant context. Fixed, company-scoped identity directory reads use the existing identity pool role; no credential/email fields are projected. Merely selecting a content owner does not grant knowledge-publishing or module-management privileges.
schema: 116_lead_assistant_settings.sql adds generic tenant-RLS settings, releases and append-only audit tables. Explicitly revokes inherited default table grants from migration 010 before granting least privilege, so app-role release update/delete is denied.
deployment: Build Runtime and apply migration 116 using the normal owner-operated Runtime migration runner after 115. No production migration was executed in this task.
Apply scripts/sql/bm_lead_assistant_navigation.sql with the authorized identity database owner to register the menu for existing active companies with Runtime customers.

Deploy the Business Manager backend (Express) and frontend together. Runtime deployment is only needed as part of the established migration packaging/release process; no new Runtime HTTP controller was added.
Use a current active business owner/Chief Executive account. Other staff cannot configure settings in this slice; later inbox/advisor roles are separate work.
Open Business Manager → Leads & Conversations, configure the draft and publish. Published settings alone do not activate WhatsApp or change an agent release.

verification.backend: 20 tests passed: validation, actual isolated PostgreSQL migration/RLS/least-privilege, tenant spoofing, active staff, revoked authority, concurrent creation/stale edits, incomplete publication, immutable release/idempotent publication, navigation and real-estate characterization.
verification.browser: 16 tests passed at desktop 1902x1016 and mobile 390x844; includes shared controls, draft/publish flow, server validation, cancelled team searches, reload confirmation, access denied, lazy route/navigation and light/dark computed layout checks.
verification.compile: Application TypeScript check passed; production frontend build passed with NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=2 outside sandbox. Initial standard build hit an esbuild deadlock; successful retry is the final build evidence. Existing font-budget/CommonJS/primeicons warnings remain.
verification.architectureCheck: check-sophia-boundaries.mjs exits 1 on two pre-existing vendor-import violations in student-document-analysis.worker.ts and student-document-analysis.worker.spec.ts; both tracked files match HEAD and are unchanged by this work.
verification.hygiene: JavaScript syntax, JSON parsing and both git diff --check checks passed. No production/provider requests, real messages or new connections.
